caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular cloth bordered in a pale blue, with a central area containing a beige background. Arranged along three sides of the rectangle (the top, right, and bottom sides) are small gray houses with red doors and chimneys emitting wavy smoke, situated behind yellow picket fences. Around the houses and fences are stylized trees with green canopies dotted with red, possibly representing fruit. Scattered in each corner and along the sides are groups of figures wearing long, flowing dresses in pastel shades of pink, blue, and purple. Some of the figures are holding umbrellas matching their dresses. The bottom edge features two figures facing each other, one in a blue dress and one in pink, both under a shared blue umbrella. The figures have no visible facial features and are simple in design. The entire scene is flat, with objects outlined in black, and the illustration employs soft, muted colors throughout.
title: Table Cover
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
